recommended_strategy: Download https://altecklighting.com/products.json?limit=250&page=1 (confirm page 2 empty). Match variants[].sku exactly. Image: variants[].featured_image.src when present (multi-finish products); 124 of 195 variants have no featured_image (mostly single-variant products) -> use product.images[0].src. For multi-variant products without featured_image, pick product.images whose filename starts with the SKU (filenames embed SKU, e.g. AW0052-3CCT-W-BK-1.jpg), else images[0].
notes: Caveat: some filenames use a different finish/CCT code than the variant (e.g. AW0054-30-W-BK images named AW0054-CCT-W-BK-1.jpg; AW0120-3CCT-W-WH featured image named AW0120-3CCT-W-MH-1.jpg), so prefer featured_image / variant_ids over filename matching. Product images include application (lifestyle) shots - take the first non-'application' image as the primary.
